label: Showreel BGM 规格(对标 ObiN/Bohdan/Aftermagics 等 7 条音频)

bpm.note: 快 montage 偏高(140-150);高潮段更快。卡点:剪辑切点落在每 2 拍或 4 拍(124BPM→每拍0.48s,1-1.2s/镜≈每2-3拍切一次,正好接快节奏)。

loudness.note: 无人声时音乐可到 -16;有人声时 duck 到 VO 之下 ~9dB。

style: modern motion design soundtrack, clean editorial tech brand music, minimal premium tone, glossy synth design, busy percussion grid, fast sync points, up-tempo

variants.A: tighter syncopated electronic groove with crisp rim clicks, short hats, and controlled low kicks
variants.B: heavier halftime pulse with deeper kicks, sparse snares, and restrained metallic percussion
variants.C: faster broken-beat pattern with shuffled hats, micro fills, and punchy transition hits

negativePrompt: no vocals, no lyrics, no acoustic singer-songwriter style, no cinematic orchestra, no trap vocal chops, no copyrighted melody, no lo-fi vinyl noise, no overly distorted drums, no long ambient intro
promptTemplate: Create a {duration} second instrumental audio cue for a premium motion design showreel, around {bpm} BPM, matching this style: {style}. Keep a polished tech-brand atmosphere, glossy synth design, clean edit points, risers, impacts, short transitions, and spatial width. Do not use vocals or recognizable melodies. Change only the drum pattern to {variant}. Preserve a clear energy curve that builds to a climax and a clean ending.

beatSync.rule: 拿到 BGM 后检测 BPM/拍点 → 把分镜 scene 边界吸附到最近拍点(卡点);高潮段每拍或每半拍切。
beatSync.hitTimesNote: 参考片的逐拍 hit_times 在用户拆解 audio_analysis.csv;本 skill 用 vibemotion music sync 现场检测所选曲的拍点。

source: 拆解 7 条对标片音频(ObiN/Bohdan/Aftermagics/Varchasva/ARIA):BPM 90-148、清亮电子打击、editorial tech 氛围、快 sync points。详见 references/teardowns/showreel/audio.md
